presentationTable.name: Product

presentationColumns.name: SKU Code
presentationColumns.description: Business-facing SKU code. Use it to identify the exact sellable product variant.

presentationColumns.name: Style Code
presentationColumns.description: Style-level code grouping related SKU variants such as sizes or colors.

presentationColumns.name: Product Name
presentationColumns.description: Readable product name for the SKU.

presentationColumns.name: Style Description
presentationColumns.description: Short description of the style family. Use it when SKU-level names are too granular.

presentationColumns.name: Department
presentationColumns.description: Top-level product department, such as Womenswear or Accessories.

presentationColumns.name: Category
presentationColumns.description: Product category within the department, such as Bags, Dresses, or Sneakers.

presentationColumns.name: Subcategory
presentationColumns.description: More detailed product grouping within the category.

presentationColumns.name: Brand
presentationColumns.description: Brand or house label associated with the product.

presentationColumns.name: Color Family
presentationColumns.description: Color family for the SKU, useful for assortment and trend analysis.

presentationColumns.name: Fit
presentationColumns.description: Fit classification for apparel or footwear products.

presentationColumns.name: Price Tier
presentationColumns.description: Commercial price tier, useful for comparing entry, premium, and luxury behavior.

presentationColumns.name: List Price
presentationColumns.description: Standard list price before discounts or markdowns.

presentationColumns.name: Standard Cost
presentationColumns.description: Standard product cost used for margin and inventory value calculations.

presentationColumns.name: Trend Tag
presentationColumns.description: Trend or style signal associated with the product, useful for merchandising analysis.

presentationColumns.name: Sustainability Flag
presentationColumns.description: Flags SKUs positioned as sustainable or using sustainability-related attributes.

presentationColumns.name: Carryover Flag
presentationColumns.description: Flags products carried over from a previous season rather than newly introduced.

presentationTable.description: Core product and SKU dimension used for style, category, assortment, price, and product attribute analysis.
